sentences.text: She is in a big city.
Her magic is small and quiet.
Today, Elara is in the park.
A purple door in a green park is very strange.
This world is a big forest.
A small creature is in the forest.
The dragon is red and small.
Suddenly, a big shadow is in the forest.
The shadow is not a friend.
Her magic is a small light.
The light is white and bright.
The big shadow is not happy.
This new world is her world too.
Elara is a student of magic now.
She is a protector of two worlds.

questions.text: Is the shadow good or bad?
